subject: OPEN statement
notes: RULE: 'The file connector referenced by file-name-1 shall not be open. If it is open, the execution of the OPEN statement is unsuccessful and the I-O status associated with file-name-1 is set to \'41\'.' cite.py --check 14.9.27.4 on the rule text: OK (§14.9.27.4 2)); the status is §9.1.13.7 1) 'I-O status = 41. An OPEN statement or a DELETE FILE statement that is attempted for a file connector in an open mode.' CODE: FileConnector.Open line 175 — 'if (IsOpen) return Status = FileStatusCode.FileAlreadyOpen;' is the FIRST statement, BEFORE 'Mode = mode' / ModeKnown / OptionalAbsent / LastReadUnsuccessful are touched, so the 'unsuccessful' half holds too: the open connector keeps its existing mode and position. PROBE (out-b1/probe/openbasic/OPBAS01.cob, sequential, --std default 2023): OPEN OUTPUT F ⇒ '00'; a second OPEN OUTPUT F ⇒ '41'. Spec-derived expected: '41'. Matches. COVERING TEST: tests/WiseOwl.Cobol.Tests.Unit/FileStatusDisciplineTests.cs ReadGate_AlreadyOpen41DropsIt_DeleteIs43 asserts Status == FileAlreadyOpen after a second Open on an open connector, and its following DeleteRecord answering '43' (not '49') proves the connector kept its I-O mode — both halves of GR2. Its expected values are derived from §9.1.13.7 items 1 and 3, not from an oracle. || EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED: 1985 · 2002 · 2014 · 2023
